notes.title: Rosewater Patch 4
notes.content:
v 1.04
----------
- Fixed a bug where Harley wouldn't properly stand up and walk out of the hotel lobby after sitting to speak with companions
- Fixed bug where it was possible to access the main menu by pressing Esc in the watch repair closeup and make gears disappear if they were the active cursor
- Fixed bug where it was possible to access the main menu by pressing Esc in the pheasant hunt closeup and would cause the game to hang if a companion was shooting

- Made hotspot for the wires in the Gannet Island facility more visible
- Fixed a crash that would happen outside Enebro Square Park
- Fixed a bug where background speech wouldn't stay onscreen when voice volume was lowered to 0
- Fixed a bug where wrong diary text would display after putting out the fire at the post office
- Fixed a crash when asking Danny about the communications relay
- Fixed various graphical bugs

notes.title: Rosewater 2-Week Anniversary Patch (v 1.03)
notes.content:
v 1.03
----------
- Fixed graphical error where foreground object baseline was incorrect in Lola's Wagon Exterior during the forest scenes
- Added companion relationship tracker to New Game+ (Access by pressing Ctrl+R)
- Fixed a bug where it was possible to open the inventory by pressing I while diaries and books were open
- Fixed a bug where it was possible to pick up the pistol from outside the test chamber
- Fixed a bug where pressing pause while the cursor wasn't an inventory item wouldn't reset the correct cursor
- Optimized skipping the opening cutscene
- You can now deliver the box to the union after getting the pin
- Pressing the right mouse button no longer skips cutscenes
- Lowered Danny's high relationship excursion threshold slightly

notes.title: Western point and click adventure Rosewater is out now
notes.content:
One classic point and click adventure game fans have been excited about has arrive. Rosewater, a Western adventure in the alternate 19th century world of Lamplight City from Grundislav Games and Application Systems Heidelberg is out now with Native Linux support.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/04/western-point-and-click-adventure-rosewater-is-out-now/

notes.title: Rosewater Patch 2
notes.content:
Rosewater has been patched to v 1.02

Changes in this patch:
- Set Dynamic Shadows to off by default on MacOS
- Added note about Dynamic Shadows affecting game performance when hovering over the button in the Settings menu
- Corrected mismatching audio/text for Jem's conversation outside the theater
- Fixed crash when disagreeing with Lola about Geggy's name at the campfire
- Fixed bug where Cormac would fall if you entered the room while he was lassoed
- Fixed characters being lit incorrectly on the wagon after the scrub camp scene
- Fixed random crashes caused by tween transparency timers
- Fixed bug where pressing the hint highlighter right before a cutscene would cause the game to hang
- Fixed bug where Alt+tabbing out of the game while paused in fullscreen would resume the audio when returning, even if paused

Changes in v 1.01:
- Fixed typos in dates in Clark's diary
- Fixed bug in Herbs excursion where leaving the room after sedating the badger made it impossible to give Nadine the snakeroot
- Fixed a potential crash when accessing the menu in the screen with the wagon during the Moving Pictures vignette
- Fixed a bug where Captain Boylan would never sound the dinner gong.
- Fixed a bug where dialogue box would disappear during the final showdown

notes.title: Rosewater review
notes.content:
Rosewater is Francisco González’s latest adventure game set in the alternate history of Lamplight City. It swaps the murky Victorian gutters of its predecessor for cacti and lavender sunsets in a reimagined American West circa 1850. But as hard as I try to imagine myself as a 'venturin' cowpoke, I wind up feeling more like a prospector, sifting through dust in hopes of finding the gold that I see glimmers of out here

notes.title: Rosewater: Dev Commentary and Q&A - AdventureX Sale 2024
notes.content:
[h3]Event Information[/h3]
We're part of the AdventureX Sales Event from Nov. 4 - Nov. 11. We'll run multiple events and announce them here. Apologies if you see several announcements.

[h3]Dev Insights and Commentary[/h3]
Join developer Francisco Gonzalez and publisher Volker Ritzhaupt as they discuss the development of the game, demonstrating concept art, animation tests, and other behind-the-scenes content. Followed by a playthrough of the demo.

[h3]About Rosewater[/h3]
Rosewater is a thrilling Western adventure set in an alternate 19th century. Harley Leger and her ragtag posse embark on a harrowing journey across Western Vespuccia, encountering bandits, rebels, visionaries, eccentrics, and many more friends and foes on their quest for fame and riches.

Join us on the store page to watch the stream [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1226670/Rosewater/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1226670/Rosewater/[/url]

notes.title: Have you played Lamplight City?
notes.content:
Excited for Rosewater but have yet to play Lamplight City? There's no time like the present!

Play the detective adventure that started the World of Vespuccia franchise, and get to know the alternate history setting that Rosewater shares.

FEATURES:
- Investigate crime scenes, interrogate suspects, get information by any means necessary. Follow the law or make your own rules, but how you choose to act will affect people's attitudes towards you.
- Five cases to solve, with multiple suspects, false leads, and different outcomes.
- Never find yourself stuck in a dead-end situation. If the case becomes unsolvable, simply move on to the next one. The story will adapt based on your choices.
- Inspired by the works of Edgar Allan Poe and Charles Dickens.
-  Meet over 50 professionally voiced characters.
-  Original score by Mark Benis

Do you need to play Lamplight City to enjoy Rosewater? No, but you'll definitely get more of the references!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/761460/Lamplight_City/]Check out Lamplight City here.[/url]

notes.title: Milestone hit: All voiceover recorded
notes.content:
[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/F5chCo8XcAALVIc?format=jpg&name=medium[/img]

On September 7th, we recorded the final voiceover session with Maya Murphy, who plays Harley Leger. This means all the voiceover for Rosewater has now been recorded!

The final line count is roughly 15,800…the biggest number in a game I’ve ever made!

Rosewater is still on track for release in Spring 2024.
